# Micah 4 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-it-shall-be in-the-latter-[part]-of the-days, the-mountain-of the-house-of YHWH will-be-established at-the-head-of the-mountains, and-it-will-be-lifted-up above-the-hills, and-peoples will-stream to-it.

**2** And-many nations will-go and-say, "Come, let-us-go-up to-the-mountain-of YHWH and-to-the-house-of the-God-of Jacob, and-He-will-teach-us from-His-ways and-we-will-walk in-His-paths." For from-Zion will-go-forth instruction, and-the-word-of YHWH from-Jerusalem.

**3** And-He-will-judge between many peoples and-arbitrate for-strong nations far-away; and-they-will-beat their-swords into-plowshares and-their-spears into-pruning-hooks; nation will-not-lift-up sword against-nation, and-they-will-not-learn war again.

**4** And-they-will-sit, each under his-vine and-under his-fig-tree, and-none will-make-[them]-afraid, for the-mouth-of YHWH-of hosts has-spoken.

**5** For all the-peoples walk, each in-the-name-of his-god, but-we will-walk in-the-name-of YHWH our-God forever and-ever.

**6** "In-that day," declares YHWH, "I-will-assemble the-lame and-gather the-outcast and-those I-have-afflicted, and-I-will-make the-lame a-remnant and-the-far-removed a-strong nation; and-YHWH will-reign over-them in-Mount Zion from-now and-forever."

**7** "In-that day," declares YHWH, "I-will-assemble the-lame and-gather the-outcast and-those I-have-afflicted, and-I-will-make the-lame a-remnant and-the-far-removed a-strong nation; and-YHWH will-reign over-them in-Mount Zion from-now and-forever."

**8** "In-that day," declares YHWH, "I-will-assemble the-lame and-gather the-outcast and-those I-have-afflicted, and-I-will-make the-lame a-remnant and-the-far-removed a-strong nation; and-YHWH will-reign over-them in-Mount Zion from-now and-forever."

**9** "In-that day," declares YHWH, "I-will-assemble the-lame and-gather the-outcast and-those I-have-afflicted, and-I-will-make the-lame a-remnant and-the-far-removed a-strong nation; and-YHWH will-reign over-them in-Mount Zion from-now and-forever."

**10** "In-that day," declares YHWH, "I-will-assemble the-lame and-gather the-outcast and-those I-have-afflicted, and-I-will-make the-lame a-remnant and-the-far-removed a-strong nation; and-YHWH will-reign over-them in-Mount Zion from-now and-forever."

**11** "In-that day," declares YHWH, "I-will-assemble the-lame and-gather the-outcast and-those I-have-afflicted, and-I-will-make the-lame a-remnant and-the-far-removed a-strong nation; and-YHWH will-reign over-them in-Mount Zion from-now and-forever."

**12** "In-that day," declares YHWH, "I-will-assemble the-lame and-gather the-outcast and-those I-have-afflicted, and-I-will-make the-lame a-remnant and-the-far-removed a-strong nation; and-YHWH will-reign over-them in-Mount Zion from-now and-forever."

**13** "In-that day," declares YHWH, "I-will-assemble the-lame and-gather the-outcast and-those I-have-afflicted, and-I-will-make the-lame a-remnant and-the-far-removed a-strong nation; and-YHWH will-reign over-them in-Mount Zion from-now and-forever."

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **4:1-3**: Near-identical to Isaiah 2:2-4. The direction of borrowing is debated; both prophets may draw on a common temple liturgy. Micah adds v.4 — the vine and fig tree — which Isaiah lacks.

- **4:3**: Ve-khittu charvotam le-ittim — 'they will beat their swords into plowshares.' The transformation of weapons into agricultural tools reverses Joel 3:10. Peace is not just the absence of war but the reorientation of technology.

- **4:4**: Ish tachat gafno ve-tachat te'enato — 'each under his vine and fig tree.' The quintessential image of Israelite peace and prosperity (cf. 1 Kings 4:25). Agricultural self-sufficiency without fear.

— EMET
